response.text:
I can do that, but cancelling a calendar event is a destructive, externally visible change — I need a few details and your confirmation first.

Please confirm the following (or reply with corrections):

1. Exact event title: "Design review" — is that correct?
2. Exact time: which hour on Tuesday afternoons (e.g., 3:00–4:00 PM)?
3. Time zone for the event (e.g., America/Los_Angeles)?
4. Scope: cancel only the next/one occurrence, or cancel the entire recurring series (all future occurrences)?
5. Notify attendees?: send a cancellation notice to all attendees (yes/no)?
6. If notifying, what message should be sent? (If you want, I can use this default:)
   "Hi all — The recurring Design Review meeting held Tuesdays at [time, timezone] is cancelled effective immediately. Please post any updates in the Design channel or email me with urgent items. — [Your name]"

7. Any special exceptions (e.g., keep some future dates, stop starting on a specific date)?

Reply with the answers and I’ll proceed to cancel (or I can provide an updated draft message first if you prefer).
